entities.summary: Nadera Shalhoub-Kevorkian is a feminist scholar whose work focuses on trauma, state crimes and criminology, surveillance, gender violence, law, and society and genocide studies. Born and raised in Haifa, Israel, and residing in Jerusalem, she is a noted Israeli-Palestinian feminist. She is the Global Chair in Law at Queen Mary University of London. She reportedly retired from her position at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem (HUJI) in late August 2024.
